title: Jangan Dicium
overview: After a long-term relationship, Jali risks losing his chance to marry Ainun—all because his body odor is potent enough to knock out his prospective in-laws. Now, Jali is in a race against time to find a way to smell fresh before Ainun is married off to someone else. Can Jali save his romance, or will his body odor end up being his final "partner"?

title: AUL: The Forgotten Wolf
overview: In a village beneath a geothermal power plant, a local militia controls public order as a cover for its illegal operations. One night, a confrontation with Mala (50), a father who begins questioning their authority, ends in his murder. Hours earlier, he entrusts his karinding to his son, Gal (25), as if passing on a final mission. After witnessing his father's death, Gal accuses the militia, but no one believes him. Guided by the karinding, he enters a realm where myth and reality converge to uncover the truth and awaken his community's forgotten conscience.

title: The Other Side of Makassar City
original_title: The Other Side of Makassar City
overview: The Other Side of Makassar City is a documentary film that explores the lives of people whose stories are rarely represented in the city’s image of progress.

title: At Friend's House
overview: Banji is at the absolute lowest point of his life. Wandering aimlessly while enduring starvation, fate reunites him with Tohan, an old friend who immediately invites him home and offers a plate of rice. However, that warmth shatters into a harsh reality when Banji learns the bitter truth: Tohan was recently laid off, his sibling is severely ill, and they survive solely by selling handmade teddy bears. Overwhelmed with guilt for consuming Tohan's precious food, Banji is instead gifted two teddy bears as a lifeline to rebuild his life.

title: Air Pangea
overview: A man prepares for death, washing and wrapping himself in the kafan as his mother reminds him only deeds and prayers matter. As the soul transcends the body, it confronts visions of the afterlife — demonic figures, mythical creatures, three guarded doors — exploring death through sex, drugs, and rock and roll as much as ritual and prayer. Plunged into a metaphorical sea of memory, love, and loss, he searches for his mother's voice amid the waves. He awakens on a lake shore met by angels. What lies beyond the waterfall? Sex drugs rock and roll?

title: A Story About Tiger's Roar
overview: Amid the harsh realities of life in Jakarta, Martha, a single mother working as a laundry worker, struggles to provide for her three year old son, Aldi. When Aldi begs for milk at a minimarket, Martha realizes she doesn’t have enough money. She almost steals it but backs out in fear. Desperate, Martha seeks help from her ex-husband and customers, but every door is closed. Mounting financial pressure and Aldi’s relentless cries push her further into despair. When her work is disrupted and a customer refuses to pay, she loses hope. Martha returns to the minimarket, waiting for the right.

title: One Scan Away
overview: Stranded walletless in Japan during his sister’s medical emergency, an Indonesian student finds his ultimate lifeline in a single QR code.

title: Dissidence - Two Shadows on the Wall
original_title: Dissidence. Deux ombres sur le mur
overview: Ravianto and Raviandi Ramadhan are two newcomers to the World Climbing Championships scene. Driven only by passion and lofty aspirations, two Indonesian twin brothers set out into the world without sponsors. The documentary "Dissidence" chronicles their incredible trip from the fabled crags of France to the climbing walls of their native country. It is a heartfelt homage to their bravery, fraternity, and tenacity. Ravianto and Raviandi fight to have their views heard internationally while challenging the current quo.

title: Esok Masih Ada
overview: Emelie, an elementary school student, must endure the taunts and bullying of her peers. Everything—from her school bag to her simple packed lunch—is turned into a source of mockery, slowly shattering her mental well-being.

title: The Doll Ghawiah
overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.

title: The Longest Wait
overview: The first feature-length documentary on the journey of the Indonesian National Team. From the struggles on the pitch to capturing moments in the Indonesian national team's dressing room to qualify FIFA World Cup 2026

title: The Sea Speaks His Name
overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

title: WATERMARK
overview: Bu Rani, a geprek chicken stall owner with a traumatic past of being falsely accused, unknowingly receives a fake 100,000-Rupiah toy bill. When her son attempts to spend the money at a local store, a wave of paranoia triggers an absurd neighborhood raid led by an overzealous RT chief. In a community fractured by distrust and untraceable cash, digital payment becomes their ultimate watermark of truth and redemption.

title: Where The Tree Stands
overview: A teenager haunted by the lingering shadow of a conflict with a friend that took place years ago. Each of them has their own hidden struggles until one of their friends tries to bring back the memories and the atmosphere of the past.

title: Meong, Bikul, dan Kisah Si Pemburu
original_title: Meong, Bikul, dan Kisah Si Pemburu
overview: A boy wants to prove himself by carrying out Siwaratri: no food, no drinks, no moving, no talking, and no sleep. While doing it, he experiences an imaginative journey as a hunter, and learns the true meaning of self-control and attentiveness.

title: The Creator
overview: For the Sasak indigenous People community, Cilokaq is not merely a form of entertainment, but a space for expression and identity-building that enjoyed great success during the VCD era; as a second-generation member of the Cilokaq Slemor Ate Jelantik group, Ojan utilises the digital space to revive this traditional music in its purest form amidst a modern industry landscape dictated by social media algorithms and artificial intelligence (AI).

title: Pasukan Singa Kardus
overview: Akmal and his three best friends roam around Singkawang wearing a cardboard barongsai, searching for someone that can teach them the proper way to lion dance.

title: Chopped
overview: Tama and his dad runs a famous fish shop at a market. He will soon take over the business when his dad retires, yet Tama has this lingering thought that his strict dad won't approve him. Although, reality sometimes differs.

title: Forza
overview: An impoverished thirteen-year-old adolescent from the slums of Bali finds his aspirations of professional football within reach after forming an unlikely partnership with a veteran athlete on the verge of retirement, culminating in an unprecedented trial with the AC Milan Youth Academy in Italy.

title: Samasta Allegra
overview: Allegra is transported to a world where vegetables, the thing she hates the most, can speak. She meets Dewi Sri, a sorceress that is slowly losing her power. Allegra needs to help Dewi Sri before this magical vegetable world vanishes.

title: Katumbiri Nutug Leuwi
overview: Believing that rainbows that reaches the river can bring magic, a group of children bands together to clean a river, hoping that angels may appear.

title: Togel: Diantara PHK dan Hutang
overview: After losing his job, Agus pretends to leave for work every morning to spare his pregnant wife the truth. Instead, he roams the streets looking for work and borrowing money just to survive. When Rijal, an old friend with a gambling habit and a talent for bad decisions, reappears, Agus tries his luck with a lottery "magic book" that promises winning numbers. Instead of getting rich, he is chased by debt collectors and forced to hide from his wife's family. Things get stranger when he meets Om Jhon, a quirky ghost who claims to know the secret to lucky numbers. Desperate for one number to change his life, Agus is pulled into a chaotic, darkly funny adventure.

title: Unreturning
overview: Pulang tapi Hilang follows Dika, a young man who returns home after spending time away studying at an Islamic boarding school. But things don't feel the same as he remembers. Everything seems familiar, yet something feels different. There's an emptiness he can't quite explain, as if a part of home is no longer there. Rika is finally home, but somehow, it doesn't feel like it anymore.

title: Tabungan Yang Dimakan Waktu
overview: A high school student realizes that her cash savings for college are damaged.

title: Sirkular
overview: When her mother falls ill, Putri becomes responsible of her mother's profession of clam-shucking. This role slowly takes Putri to repeat the same tragic cycle that her mother unfortunately experienced.

title: Satu Bungkus
overview: Having just recently transferred to a public school from a private one, Bella is still trying to blend in with her high school peers. After Bella's phone gets stolen, the four of them scours Glodok to hopefully find her phone back.

title: For Me, For You
overview: Haunted by the collateral damage of his own ego, a young man sits with a notebook of past regrets and attempts to heal by leaving behind a message of forgiveness rather than fear.

title: Our Son
overview: Two childless married couples raise an unexpected son from an illicit affair between the two households. Amidst the chaos that follows a paternity reveal, the two wives take parenting into their own hands.

title: C'mon, Please!
overview: Erol, Kenzie, and Akmal were students eating and relaxing together at a meatball stall. Suddenly, Akmal ran into his friend, Mahesa, and the two became engrossed in a long conversation. This left Erol and Kenzie feeling awkward and bored. They exchanged subtle signals, hoping to head home soon. After a long wait, Mahesa finally said his goodbyes. Erol and Kenzie felt relieved when Akmal suggested they leave, effectively bringing the tedious situation to an end.

title: Bajau Laut - The Sea is Our Home
original_title: Bajau Laut - The Sea is Our Home
overview: Their stilt houses are burned down, their boats destroyed: the sea nomads of Borneo are stateless and can be displaced at any moment. The film explores the deep cultural roots and spiritual heritage of the Bajau Laut – the first inhabitants of the Semporna region – and contrasts them with the forced evictions targeting their oldest and most traditional villages. In the tension between eradication and assimilation, three chapters trace the evolution of adaptation, while local grassroots movements fight for the rights of the sea nomads.

title: First Step
overview: As the 100th-day memorial for her younger sibling approaches, 62-year-old Tan Man Moy joins a line-dance community in Petak Enam. As happiness slowly finds its way back into her life, she must confront the guilt of enjoying life again without the person she loved most.

title: Poké Wayang: The Forest Where "Good Morning" Disappeared
original_title: Poké Wayang: Hutan Tanpa Selamat Pagi
overview: Well, here we are in Sunrise Forest... But wait, something seems a bit strange.

title: Seethe
overview: Ever since her father's sudden death by the Ciliwung River, Aci and her mother’s lives changed forever. Convincing herself the Ciliwung Spirit killed him, Aci vows revenge. Yet, her mother repeatedly insists asthma was the cause. Exhausted by Aci's escalating terror, her mother recklessly summons the entity, triggering an inevitable clash.

title: Free Kick
overview: After Ronaldo's free kick shatters a villager's window, he and his friends are forced to wander through the neighborhood in search of a field where they can continue playing.

title: The Year Without Summer
overview: Extreme heat and fires sweep through Tambora, one of Jakarta's most densely populated neighborhoods. Uus returns after years away to live with his brother, Surya, an AC technician. Disturbed by the cramped conditions and constant threat of fires, Uus is determined to move to Japan for a better life, urging Surya to join him.

title: Pirunduk
overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.

title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
overview: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

title: On a Bright Blessed Day
overview: Gita, an island woman traumatized by the sea, urges her fiancé Dama—a fisherman—to become a tour guide. Caught between the land and the sea, the two must choose one.

title: Siti Vampire
overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

title: Beautiful Pain
overview: Amidst a contentious divorce, a single mother secures an unexpected breakthrough in the film industry to establish financial independence, only to face institutional workplace hazards and a predatory custody battle orchestrated by her former spouse.

title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
overview: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

title: Dear Candidate,
overview: Uki, a Visual Communication Design fresh graduate who is still unemployed, suddenly receives an unexpected online job interview with no time to prepare. Living in a remote plantation area with poor signal, he must search for a stable connection while dealing with frustrating miscommunication with an impatient HR representative, all in hopes of passing the interview and securing a job.

title: The Class: Online
overview: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

title: Limbung
overview: In his old age, Lazuardi, a former detective who raised a vampire child as atonement for his sins, is faced with the reopening of his old case, while the vampire child started to feel distant.

title: Bekel-Bekelan
overview: An unexpected incident! A teenager find six "Bekel Balls" left in front of his door. What happens next? No one knows. But don't take it too seriously. Because what happens next isn't important anyway... At least for him.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: From me, Your little poet
overview: A poet who brought his wife back to life through poetry.

title: Home, Almost
overview: A story about an MMA fighter who finds himself in another fight on the way home. — with his father and younger brother by his side, finding the true meaning of family along the way.

title: Ghosthing
overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

title: Meditation and the Culture of Sound
original_title: Meditation and the Culture of Sound
overview: Capturing the atmosphere of a bus stop and the bustling streets of Surabaya.

title: Aplikasi Iblis
overview: A year has passed since the tragic death of his beloved Laras, yet Arya remains trapped in the depths of his grief. Haunted by longing and consumed by his love for her, Arya turns to a mysterious app called “I LET YOU IN,” rumored to have the power to connect the living with the dead. But what begins as a desperate attempt to reach Laras soon becomes a terrifying nightmare. Blinded by love, Arya unknowingly opens the door to a horrifying terror—one that threatens to consume him and put his own life at risk. Can Arya find the strength to let Laras go before his love for her becomes the very thing that costs him his life?

title: Dendam Arwah Penari
overview: The bankruptcy of Mr. Kusuma’s business forced Harum and her family to move into an old family home. There, Harum discovered a mysterious shawl that turned out to harbor the grudge of a dancer from the past. Since then, a series of terrifying and strange events has begun to haunt Harum and her family. To put an end to this deadly terror, Harum must uncover the mystery behind the dancer’s unjust death.

title: Bapak Paling Jujur
overview: A highly calculated gubernatorial candidate finds his meticulously engineered political campaign and public persona thrown into absolute disarray when a maternal curse renders him entirely incapable of deception, forcing him to navigate the political arena with unfiltered, absolute honesty.

title: Hapus
overview: Key is on probation at a production house. Her boss asks her to erase a mysterious figure from a video, a figure standing behind a “history expert” who is about to talk about the 1998 tragedy. She tries again and again, and fails, while strange things keep happening to her. A short horror film about the 1998 riots and the erasure of history.

title: KILL KILL BANG BANG
overview: A restaurant worker just wants to finish her shift and go home, but the night has other plans for her.

title: A Season
overview: Eric, a young Bali based heir used to a life of ease, until Sonya’s motorbike collides with his car on a coastal road. Sharp, unpredictable, and playing by her own rules, Sonya pulls Eric into a relationship that blurs every boundary he thought he understood. As their connection intensifies, Eric is forced to face a truth he has spent his life avoiding: nothing lasts forever, not wealth, not pleasure, not even love.

title: Moko: Bisikan Logam Tua
overview: Behind the beauty of the sea and the calm hills of Alor Island, lies the mystery of an old bronze drum called Moko, an inanimate object with magical powers that is believed to be able to come to life, change form, and even demand sacrifices. But for the Abui people, Moko is more than just a sacred myth; it's a wedding dowry and an "eternal debt" that can delay burial and force parents to sweat until their last drop of blood. Through Yoel's emotional narrative and the silent cries of the guardians of tradition, this documentary reveals a profound question: where is the line between inherited dignity and the shackles that cost humanity tears?

title: Syekh Yusuf Al-Makassari: In The Blessing of Ceylon
original_title: Syekh Yusuf Al-Makassari: In The Blessing of Ceylon
overview: From the Indonesian archipelago to Ceylon and beyond, Syekh Yusuf’s journey is a story of knowledge, faith, resilience, and connections that crossed borders and generations. His legacy continues to connect the histories and cultures of Indonesia and the wider Indian Ocean world.

title: Rainy Day Mother
overview: A mother revisits her old family photographs, now damaged by floodwaters. As she sifts through the fading images, she and her son engage in occasional conversations about religion and marriage.

title: Antrian Nomor Kematian
overview: Nur rushes her critically ill father to a referral hospital, only to find herself trapped in a grueling battle against rigid bureaucracy. Amidst this agonizing delay, her father's condition rapidly deteriorates.

title: The Journal: Starting From Research
original_title: The Journal: Berawal Dari Sebuah Penelitian
overview: A team of three book writers, try to research the life of one of their friends named Fika for the next 30 days. To get accurate results, they have to stay overnight at Fika's house. Initially the research went smoothly until finally strange things happened and of course Fika's behavior changed. Whether all this happened by chance or there was something behind this event.

title: Ibuku
overview: A destitute widow and former traditional dancer defies social ostracization to embark on a desperate international journey, seeking a final reconciliation with her estranged daughter who faces execution abroad for the murder of an abusive employer.

title: Cidro Asmoro
overview: When a musician's composition achieves unexpected digital virality through a café waitress's unauthorized cover, a commercial strategist orchestrates a collaborative duet between the two artists, igniting an interpersonal conflict driven by their sharply contrasting professional objectives.

title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

title: Hasut
overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

title: Seriously This Is the Last Time
original_title: Seriously This Is the Last Time

title: Lona's Home
overview: For her birthday, Lona (9) received a teddy bear she named Moka. The bond between Lona and Moka filled a void left by her parents—Mama (34) and Papa (35)—whose busy work schedules kept them occupied. Moka remained a steadfast companion to Lona until the day the bear disappeared just as the family was reuniting, ultimately helping to restore the harmony that had once been lost.

title: Jakarta, I Love You
overview: A birthday boy meets a lost a stranger on the Jakarta MRT.

title: Midnight Sun
overview: Surabaya is a bustling city, and this documentary captures a 24-hour cycle in the lives of three people whose lives have been shattered by circumstances beyond their control, yet who refuse to be victims.

title: A Bitter Place
overview: Saka (31) was diagnosed with an undiagnosed illness after suffering a work accident while driving a truck carrying hazardous chemicals. Saka, who did not believe in non-materialistic beliefs, visited a cult that practiced mass healing rituals. During the ritual, a riot broke out among the impatient worshippers who wanted to be healed. The cult leader appeared to heal the followers' wounds to diffuse the chaos. The incident left Saka amazed and convinced of the miracle, strengthening his faith in the cult. When it was Saka's turn to be healed, his condition worsened, and the wounds on his body grew larger. His faith began to fade, and Saka wanted to expose the cult's fraud.

title: Deadly Revision
overview: Udin is a creative worker in the field of graphic designer who is pressured by his client named Tina, a young politician who demands many things from Udin. However, Udin felt helpless with Tina's demands because he still wanted to get the next service projects. So Udin had to be forced to do what TIna wanted.

title: Tarik
overview: A boy named Ridho lives a simple life alongside his father, helping him sell vegetables each day. Amid the relentless demands of daily life, he discovers a modest sense of happiness through a handmade kite. For the very first time, he possesses something that offers him true release from the burdens he carries.  Yet for his father, manhood is defined by utility being useful, capable, and needed. Consequently, flying a kite is dismissed as trivial next to the duties that lie ahead. To Ridho, however, happiness and freedom are the very essence of what he requires.  As their values collide, Ridho must navigate a choice between clinging to his newly found joy or conforming to the life his father considers best for him.

title: The Hill and Mom's Memories
overview: Bayu (20), a film student, returns to Tuban and invites his mother (44) to revisit places that hold memories of his parents’ love story for a college assignment. As their journey unfolds, the true reason behind his mother’s stories is slowly revealed: a message for Bayu not to repeat his father’s smoking habit, which ultimately took his life.

title: Monster of The Sea Guard
overview: Stranded and unconscious at sea, then waking up from her fainting and not knowing the cause, a woman (26) has to escape from a masked human figure who feels frightening to her.

title: Quarter Century
overview: Quarter Century is a quiet exploration of a universal yet deeply personal question: What does it truly mean to exist?

title: BAHANA
overview: A mute girl living with her abusive mother creates Alan, a mysterious companion who becomes her only escape. But as reality begins to unravel, Nada must confront what Alan truly represents.

title: Ghost in the Celluloid
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Sepele
overview: After ignoring his friend’s warning about a psychopath on the loose, Denis finds himself hunted through the dark corridors of his own home. When Adit comes to save him, Denis begins to question whether he has truly escaped—or is trapped in his own fear.

title: 1st Attempt
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Cikiromantic
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Bayang
overview: Ayu (16) becomes obsessed with the beauty standards she sees in social media and magazines. Covering her mirror with notes about what it means to be “beautiful,” she pushes herself to change her appearance through makeup, dieting, and other painful efforts. As her reflection disappears behind these expectations, so does her sense of self. Overwhelmed, Ayu escapes to the beach, where an unexpected encounter with the girl she idolizes challenges her beliefs and reveals a different understanding of beauty and self-acceptance.

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
original_title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
overview: YouTube star and musician Reza Arap takes the hot seat as top Indonesian comics roast his career, controversies and persona in this comedy special.

title: Warga Rusun 609
overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
overview: Educated under colonial rule, a determined young man from Tanah Karo enlists in a paramilitary unit under the false promise of liberation, ultimately rising to become a pivotal military strategist in North Sumatra's guerrilla defense while balancing acute domestic sacrifices with absolute duty to the nascent Indonesian Republic.

title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
original_title: Lobang Buaya, 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah
overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

title: Conjurig
overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

title: Kalcer: The New Era ִ
overview: Famous for dominating their alley with their signature street style, The Kalcer (Andra, Ariel, and Milo) find their status challenged when The Siblinkz newly moved siblings Killa and Baskara arrive with an even trendier and more stylish look.

title: Crowyokan
overview: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.

title: COFFE
overview: Rendra, a migrant worker who works as a designer for a company, is enjoying his day off when he suddenly receives an urgent task from his boss. Wanting to make a cup of coffee to accompany his day off, he discovers that he has run out of coffee at home. Rendra decides to head to a cafe, but everything he does seems to go wrong, one misfortune after another, turning what was supposed to be a relaxing day off into a complete mess.

title: Lunch Time
overview: An authoritarian school principal launches a free lunch program that instead transforms the children into terrifying creatures.

title: Return of Rizal
overview: A serial killer stopped his spree because he was wanted by the police. But his evil side told him to go back. He suffered a moral crisis, deeply longing to be just a normal human being.

title: Paper Boat
overview: Perahu Kertas (Paper Boat) is a film poem about Atun, the filmmaker's childhood nanny who raised her from birth and became her chosen mother. After decades of domestic work across Indonesia and abroad, Atun now runs a roadside warung in Bali with her husband Mus and members of their extended family. To keep the business and their loved ones afloat, they work tirelessly, allowing themselves just one day off every two weeks. The film is that day off. In Atun’s brief repose from the demands of sustenance, space is made for poetic reflections on care, labour, sacrifice, and a relationship forged beyond blood.

title: Draft Me a Future
overview: Doni, feeling outmatched by his best friend, decided to create a fictional future scenario as an escape from the harsh reality.

title: Bisikan Desa Gringsing
overview: Hesti searches for her missing father whose path leads her to the cursed village of Desa Gringsing, where she becomes enmeshed in the terror of a restless spirit named Fatimah.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: Following a localized string of youth abductions and homicides, a cynical newspaper editor forms a desperate alliance with a law enforcement officer and three investigative journalists to track a missing child, uncovering a malevolent force that forces them to choose between self-preservation and lethal sacrifice.

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

title: Mother, What Would I Do Without You?
overview: Confronted with the devastating reality of her mother’s terminal diagnosis, a young woman embarks on a compressed emotional journey to fulfill her mother's final, unexpressed desires before her imminent decease, forcing a profound reckoning with grief and filial duty.

title: Tinu Ninu
overview: Being a graduate of Visual Communication Design and having worked on a graphic design project for a legislative candidate did not guarantee Nino a permanent job, even though he had graduated two years ago. His unstable employment caused Nino considerable anxiety, which made him give up on his intention to propose to Tina, his college friend, before returning to his hometown to take care of his family's fruit shop.

title: Kala
overview: On her way home from the office, Kala was forced to cancel plans with her friends to attend a sudden meeting. Her commute was disturbed by a mysterious piano melody that kept following her all the way home. The disturbance persisted and escalated during the meeting, clashing with  the relentless reprimands from her boss who kept blaming her.

title: Behind The Lens
overview: "Kedipan Kamera" is a compelling short film that delves into a sharp yet empathetic social critique of contemporary community life. Through a series of poignant visual moments captured by a camera lens, the film explores the stark contrasts within public spaces, highlighting the invisible struggles of ordinary citizens. It challenges the audience to look past the surface of daily routines and recognize the deep human stories, socio-economic gaps, and emotional resilience embedded in the local environment.

title: Four Seasons in Java
overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. But coming home also means confronting the four men who sent her to prison and now rule the village. Together with the outcasts, Pertiwi begins to uncover the darkness that still haunts the place - and the past she thought she had left behind.

title: The Absurdity Of Something That Is Divided, Absorbed,  Alienated, Gathered,  and Suctioned.
original_title: Absurditas Sebuah Yang Terbagi, Terserap, Terasing, Terkumpul, dan Terhisap.
overview: A story about a glass, when together with other glasses, always shares its water (energy) to make the other glasses not feel sad.

title: Between Time: The Flower That Bloomed Too Late
original_title: Antara Waktu: Bunga Yang Terlambat Mekar
overview: More than a century after losing her first love, Liriell lives a quiet life as a florist. Fate reunites her with the reincarnation of Willem, the man she once loved in a past life, who now lives as Malio. However, Malio is already engaged to Tamara. Caught between cherished memories, lingering regrets, and the relentless passage of time, Liriell must choose between holding on to the past or letting it go for someone else's happiness. A heartfelt story about a love that arrived too late.

title: Afternoons Feel Like Goodbyes
overview: Titi, a 24-year-old woman who has never felt a sense of meaning in her life, attempts to prepare for her own death by sewing a custom shroud, one she can wear by herself so as not to burden anyone when the time comes.

title: Obstacles
overview: Bound by address issues and average grades, Bunga's dream of getting into her ideal school is crushed. But taking a chance on a new, different path might just change everything.

title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
overview: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

title: RAPTURE
overview: A nun chooses to ascend when an angel comes to rapture her congregation. As she journeys through the pathway to the gate of heavens, she comes face to face with the irrefutable sanctity of her devotion to the Almighty.

title: Istimewa
overview: Five disabled children embark on a desperate search for their runaway foster father, only to find themselves thrust into the public eye.

title: Akal Imitasi
overview: Set in the year 2029, the story focuses on an AI-based system called PIKO in schools, and how this technology widens the gap and leads to the loss of the true essence of learning.

title: Upon the Pond
overview: Set in a mysterious lake in the land of Sunda, a siren in love with a textile factory worker embarks on a journey to discover the meaning of love and her true self.

title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
original_title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
overview: On their way to his wife's hometown in West Sumatra, Teddy and his best friend, Kevin, recklessly continue their journey at night and become lost in a forbidden area believed to be the realm of the Urang Bunian. Amidst a forest filled with supernatural terrors and illusions, they must find their way home before they disappear forever.

title: The Fox King
overview: Ali and Amir are inseparable fraternal twins with a telepathic bond. The brothers are forced to fend for themselves when their father abandons them after remarrying a younger bride. The arrival of a new teacher, Lara, tests their brotherly bond.

title: Adagium
overview: A hired hitman is paid to assassinate a corrupt politician, but after witnessing the failure of the justice system, he begins taking the law into his own hands.

title: The Feastless Soul
overview: Jeremy, a spirit with no clear identity, struggles to secure his portion on the day of the spirits' banquet.

title: Bahasa Cinta Yang Beda
overview: The married life of Cinta and Rangga, where their relationship begins to feel stagnant due to routine and unrecognized differences in their love languages.

title: The Worst First Impression
overview: A man tries to reach out to a creature in a room.

title: She Taking Care of Me
overview: Follows a personal journey to rediscover the meaning of home through an intimate relationship between two sisters. Beginning with Nabila's body, shaped by scoliosis, it reflects on emotional weight, trauma, and memories of Palu after the 2018 disaster.

title: Inong Peudame: Together, We Were Brave
original_title: Inong Peudame: Together, We Were Brave
overview: Set in Aceh, Indonesia, Inong Peudame (translated as "Women Peacemaker") tells the story of women whose courage, voices, and collective action shaped the journey toward peace during Aceh’s period as a Military Operations Area (DOM). Through the experiences of women activists, survivors, and community leaders, the documentary traces how women came together to support survivors, protect communities, and advocate for peace and justice.

title: Behind The Sins
overview: A director wanted to produce a fiction film about mining issues with local citizens, but because the story did not match reality, the local citizens decided to go home

title: my father is a tofu
overview: Conversing in a tofu factory, a boy realize that life is just like tofu: slow and fragile

title: Jangan Lupa Bahagia
overview: Following the untimely death of their parents, a resilient young adult assumes sole custody of her two younger siblings, battling escalating housing instability and economic devastation in a desperate bid to secure their education.

title: speaker freaker (the long song)
overview: Indonesian idol group no na dropped "speaker freaker (the long song)" along with its 13-minute medley short film on National Radio Day, September 11, setting the stage for their debut album, island girl, set to drop on September 18. Featuring iconic tracks like "rollerblade", "party in the +62”", and many more! Weave into traditional Indonesian elements, from the clinking of ceng-ceng cymbals in "work" and gamelan motifs in "rollerblade" to the familiar honk of city minibuses in "honk!," capturing the distinct world no na builds.

title: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan
overview: A debt-ridden, former vocalist relocates to his remote Papuan hometown under the pretense of visiting his terminally ill adoptive mother, masking a sinister plot to plunder her estate that inadvertently unleashes a lethal, ancient supernatural entity.

title: Iyus Jenius
overview: Following the tragic loss of his father, a demoralized ten-year-old boy overcomes severe emotional distress and academic decline through the guidance of an whimsical imaginary friend, who helps him reclaim his confidence and intellectual potential.

title: Maids to Order
overview: A driven entrepreneur establishes a domestic helper agency, navigating the complex and often humorous dynamics of managing her idiosyncratic staff while simultaneously resolving personal crises.

title: Until The End of Time
overview: In a world that can predict the exact moment of death, Fana, an apathetic girl with only 12 hours left to live tried to get away from the S.A.F.E. Zone (State Accomodation for Final Existence) alongside a stranger who shared the same countdown, only to rediscover her will to live just as their time runs out.

title: Who's We?
overview: On a vast, barren plain, two young men were locked in a desperate struggle over the most precious thing in their lives, regardless of whether it cost them their friendship or even their lives.

title: Disonance
overview: A documentary about a married couple navigating life amidst financial hardship, social pressure, and family rejection. Through the choices they make, the film explores the disconnect between faith, life, and reality a disconnect that creates dissonance within them and their surrounding environment.

title: Autopsy: Dead Body Can Talk
overview: Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

title: Bapakmu Kiper
overview: The story follows an 18-year-old named Ronaldhino Sujatmiko—known as Dino—who harbors anger toward his father, Warto. Warto is a former local soccer star and soccer gambler whom Dino believes is responsible for his mother’s death. Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.

title: Baby Udon
overview: Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman, falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Di perjalanan pulang setelah membantu sebuah keluarga mengusir Iblis di tubuh anak mereka, Adam (Arya Saloka) seorang pengajar agama sekaligus praktisi ruqyah mengalami kecelakaan maut yang membuatnya kehilangan Aini, istrinya. Sejak saat itu ia berhenti melakukan ruqyah dan hidup dalam kesedihan berkepanjangan. Sampai suatu hari, ia diminta Anwar (Dimas Aditya) menyelamatkan Fitri (Acha Septriasa) seorang perawat sekaligus putri dari Mansur (Donny Damara), figur yang dihormati di desa tempat Adam tinggal. Adam yang awalnya menolak menemukan alasan untuk kembali melakukan ruqyah karena mengingat pesan mendiang istrinya. Namun, seiring waktu ia menemukan ada rahasia gelap di balik terror gaib yang menimpa Fitri.

title: Paket Santet
overview: Sebuah paket tiba di depan pintu. Tidak ada nama pengirim. Tidak ada alasan mengapa paket itu ditujukan kepada mereka. Namun, sejak paket itu dibuka, hidup penerimanya langsung berubah jadi mimpi buruk. Satu per satu nyawa menjadi taruhan. Kini, pertanyaannya bukan lagi bagaimana cara menghindari paket tersebut, melainkan bagaimana cara terhindar dari kutukan setelah menerimanya.

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay (Fajar Nugra), penjual ayam di pasar yang diam-diam mencintai Wulan (Givina), nekat menggunakan sebuah cara terlarang dengan menggunakan Pelet dan ajian Pemikat Jiwa untuk membuatnya jatuh cinta dan merebutnya dari Damar (Erdin Wedrayana) calon suami Wulan. Ritual itu berhasil, Wulan pun mulai mencintai Jay secara tidak wajar.  Namun, perubahan itu segera berubah jadi teror. Wulan kehilangan kendali atas dirinya dan mulai dirasuki sosok entitas gaib bernama Nyai Sasigeni yang membuat dorongan obsesif yang semakin brutal. Hubungan mereka berubah menjadi ikatan yang mencekik.  Saat Damar berusaha menyelamatkan Wulan, Jay menyadari bahwa yang ia gunakan bukan sekadar pelet pemikat biasa, tapi pelet yang mengikat jiwa Wulan dan mengancam nyawanya. Setiap usaha untuk melepaskannya justru menuntut harga yang lebih mengerikan.

title: FOUFO
genres: Animasi, Petualangan, Komedi, Drama, Cerita Fiksi
overview: Di tengah kesulitan ekonomi di Kampung Rombeng, Muslim (Tretan Muslim), seorang pengepul rongsok keturunan Madura terdesak harus segera melunasi sisa biaya ibadah haji ibunya. Situasi berubah ketika ia menemukan bangkai UFO jatuh di pinggiran kota. Alih-alih menjual besi UFO, Muslim justru menyembunyikan UFO dan alien sekarat, lalu ia namai Foufo. Di luar dugaan, teknologi canggih Foufo berhasil menyelesaikan berbagai masalah keluarga Muslim. Namun, konflik memuncak saat tenggat waktu pelunasan haji tiba dan Foufo kehabisan energi. Muslim kini dihadapkan pada dilema krusial: memberangkatkan haji ibunya, atau membantu Foufo pulang ke kapal induknya?

title: 402 Rumah Sakit Angker Korea
overview: Demi mendapatkan 3 Juta Penonton, content creator yang dikenal dengan nama Para Pencari Hantu, memilih untuk melakukan live streaming di sebuah rumah sakit paling angker di Korea Selatan. Juna (Arbani Yasiz), Adit (Saputra Kori), Bara (Elang El Gibran), Arum (Diandra Agatha), Yuri (Lea Ciarachel), Tyas (Aylena Fusil), dan Daeho (Jang Han Sol), bukan hanya akan mendapatkan content yang menarik banyak penonton, mereka juga mendapatkan pengalaman paling mengerikan, mencekam bahkan mematikan yang tak pernah mereka bisa bayangkan sebelumnya.

title: Cerita Lila
overview: Lila, arwah seorang gadis kecil yang masih terikat pada masa lalunya, terus mencari saudari kembarnya yang hilang, Lili. Kehidupannya berubah saat Nia dan ibunya, Tari, pindah ke rumah tempat Lila berada.  Persahabatan yang terjalin antara Lila dan Nia membawa mereka pada pencarian yang perlahan membuka rahasia kelam yang lama terkubur.  Ketika kehadiran sosok Rahma mulai mengancam keselamatan mereka, Nia meminta bantuan Sara Wijayanto dan Wisnu untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik tragedi masa lalu.

title: Badut Gendong
genres: Aksi, Drama, Kengerian, Fantasi, Cerita Seru

title: Gudang Merica
overview: Belum diketahui.

title: Suzzanna: Santet Dosa di Atas Dosa
original_title: Suzzanna: Santet Dosa di Atas Dosa

title: Pelangi di Mars
overview: Kisah tentang perjuangan seorang anak dalam menghadapi tantangan hidup dan mengejar mimpi-mimpinya, yang dianalogikan seperti mencari pelangi di tempat yang mustahil (Mars). Film ini mengeksplorasi tema harapan, keluarga, dan keteguhan hati di tengah kesulitan.

title: Beyond the Screen: Reality of Indonesia Film Industry
original_title: Beyond the Screen: Reality of Indonesia Film Industry

title: Kuyank
overview: Rusmiati tak kunjung memiliki anak setelah bertahun-tahun menikah dengan Badri. Lantaran takut ditinggalkan oleh sang suami, dia nekat mempelajari ilmu hitam bernama kuyang agar selalu tampil cantik dan memesona. Sayangnya yang dipelajari Rusmiati berbuah petaka ketika efek dari ilmu itu malah meneror dan membuat nyawa warga desa melayang. Mau tak mau Rusmiati harus pun mempertanggungjawabkan atas apa yang terjadi dan bagaimana nasib Badri sebagai seorang suami yang harus menyelamatkan Rusmiati dari ilmu kuyangnya tersebut ?.

title: Surat untuk Masa Mudaku
overview: Di sebuah panti asuhan, seorang remaja pemberontak dan pengurus pendiam tanpa diduga menjadi sahabat, saat mereka berusaha untuk berdamai dengan masa lalu penuh luka.

title: Timur
genres: Aksi, Drama, Sejarah, Cerita Seru, Kejahatan

title: Lupa Daratan
overview: Tepat saat seorang aktor ternama mendapatkan peran bergengsi, kemampuan aktingnya hilang secara misterius, sehingga memicu pencarian jati diri di tengah tekanan publik.

title: Maju Serem Mundur Horor
overview: Sebuah film horor komedi Indonesia yang menceritakan kisah empat mahasiswa film yang mengharuskan mereka membuat film horor sebagai proyek akhir mereka untuk menyelesaikan studi. Namun, peristiwa mistis seperti penampakan hantu dan kerasukan mulai mengganggu proses syuting mereka, mengacaukan produksi dan keselamatan tim.

title: Abadi Nan Jaya
overview: Ramuan jamu memicu kemunculan para zombi di suatu desa. Sebuah keluarga yang tak akur harus bersatu dan berjuang untuk bertahan hidup saat kampung halaman mereka hancur.

title: Pengepungan di Bukit Duri
overview: Edwin berjanji pada kakaknya sebelum meninggal untuk menemukan anak kakaknya yang hilang. Pencarian Edwin membawanya menjadi guru di SMA Duri, sekolah untuk anak-anak bermasalah. Di sana, Edwin menghadapi murid-murid paling beringas sambil mencari keponakannya. Ketika akhirnya ia menemukan sang keponakan, kerusuhan pecah di seluruh kota dan mereka terjebak di sekolah, melawan anak-anak brutal yang kini mengincar nyawa mereka.

title: Pabrik Gula
overview: Sekelompok buruh musiman yang datang ke sebuah pabrik gula tua di pedesaan untuk bekerja selama musim panen. Namun, mereka tidak mengetahui apa rahasia di balik pabrik gula tersebut.

title: Norma: Antara Mertua dan Menantu
overview: Norma yang baru menikah berharap pernikahannya bahagia, tanpa mengetahui bahwa suaminya diam-diam berselingkuh dengan ibunya.

title: Anak Kunti
overview: Menceritakan Sarah, seorang santriwati, diusik oleh serangkaian mimpi buruk tentang Kuntilanak yang mengancamnya. Sesuai petunjuk sang pengasuh pesantren, Nyai Fatima, Sara pergi ke sebuah kampung yang angker, Wonoenggal, untuk mengungkap rahasia gelap masa lalunya.

title: Pengantin Iblis
overview: Ranti adalah seorang ibu dan istri yang amat berbakti. Ranti memiliki putri yang amat ia sayangi, tapi cacat kondisinya sejak lahir, Nina. Suatu hari Nina mengalami kecelakaan fatal yang membutuhkan penanganan segera. Namun suami Ranti yang bekerja sebagai pelaut sedang tidak berada di rumah, dan keluarga besarnya juga tidak bisa membantu Ranti. Ranti akhirnya harus mencari jalan apapun demi keselamatan Nina. Ranti terpaksa menerima tawaran untuk menjadi pengantin iblis. Akhirnya Nina dapat disembuhkan, namun ada harga lain yang harus Ranti bayar, yang menyangkut nyawa seluruh anggota keluarganya.

title: Cinta Tak Seindah Drama Korea
overview: Seorang perempuan (Lutesha) mendapatkan kejutan manis dari kekasihnya (Ganindra Bimo), yaitu berlibur ke Seoul bersama dua sahabatnya sesama pecinta drama Korea (Anya Geraldine & Dea Panendra). Tak disangka, di sana ia justru bertemu dengan cinta pertamanya ketika SMA (Jerome Kurnia). Apakah ini akan lebih dramatis dari drama Korea?

title: Santet Segoro Pitu
overview: Sejak ayahnya menemukan sebuah bungkusan misterius dan mendengar suara sekawanan suku pedalaman yang menyeramkan, ARDI dan keluarganya mengalami kejadian aneh. SUCIPTO (ayahnya), MARNI (ibunya), dan ARIF (adik laki-lakinya) satu-persatu jatuh sakit. Ardi dan adik perempuannya, SYIFA meyakini bahwa ini adalah serangan santet dan selanjutnya mereka berdua lah yang akan bernasib sama. Sebuah santet tingkat tinggi dari luar tanah Jawa yang disebut Santet Segoro Pitu.

title: Sumala
overview: Tanpa sepengetahuan Soedjiman suaminya, Sulastri melakukan perjanjian dengan iblis supaya ia bisa memiliki anak. Ia melahirkan anak kembar, Kumala yang bertahan hidup dan Sumala yang meninggal. Kumala tumbuh menjadi anak yang baik hati tapi cacat fisik dan mental. Ia sering mendapat perlakuan buruk dari orang-orang sekitarnya. Suatu hari Sumala datang dari dunia kematian dan membuat perhitungan kepada mereka yang telah menyakiti Kumala.

title: Lembayung
overview: Pica (Taskya Namya) dan Arum (Yasamin Jasem), mahasiswi keperawatan, menjalani masa PKL di Klinik Lembayung yang baru dibuka kembali setelah lama ditutup karena kasus bunuh diri. Suatu malam, pasien misterius yang menyeramkan, berambut panjang muncul di poli gigi, membuat Pica dan Arum sangat ketakutan. Sosok itu terus menghantui mereka hingga terbawa ke mimpi Arum. Peristiwa janggal mulai terjadi, diikuti dengan runutan kejadian tragis di Klinik Lembayung. Saat Arum kerasukan, Pica berusaha mengungkap misteri Klinik Lembayung sebelum sahabatnya menjadi korban berikutnya.

title: The Shadow Strays
overview: Si pembunuh belia yang terampil menentang mentornya demi menyelamatkan bocah lelaki dari sindikat kejahatan kejam. Ia akan menghancurkan siapa pun yang menghalanginya.

title: Sakaratul Maut
overview: Pak Wiryo dan istri pertamanya mengalami kecelakaan maut. Istrinya tewas di tempat, sedangkan Pak Wiryo jatuh koma dan sulit meregang nyawa karena punya ‘pegangan’. Saat Pak Wiryo menghadapi sakaratul maut, anak-anaknya dari istri pertama dan istri kedua malah sibuk berebut harta warisan. Bersamaan dengan konflik itu, rentetan teror menyerang anak-anak Pak Wiryo. Satu per satu dari mereka diteror Jin mengerikan yang bersemayam di tubuh Bapaknya.

title: Kabut Berduri
overview: Seorang detektif kota besar menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan mengerikan di sepanjang perbatasan Indonesia-Malaysia—memaksanya menghadapi hantu-hantu masa lalunya.

title: Vina: Sebelum 7 Hari
genres: Kejahatan, Kengerian, Drama, Misteri, Cerita Seru
overview: Jenazah Almarhumah Vina (Nayla Purnama) yang ditemukan di flyover Cirebon dianggap mengalami kecelakaan motor tunggal. Nenek Vina (Lydia Kandou) curiga karena tubuh Vina remuk tak wajar namun tak punya cukup bukti untuk menolak berita acara. Vina merasuki tubuh sahabatnya Linda (Gisellma Firmansyah), Ia hanya punya waktu sebelum 7 hari usai kematiannya untuk mengungkap kebenaran yang menyakitkan. Alfatihah.

title: Siksa Kubur
overview: Setelah kedua orang tuanya jadi korban bom bunuh diri Sita jadi tidak percaya agama. Sejak saat itu tujuan hidup Sita hanya satu: mencari orang yang paling berdosa dan ketika orang itu meninggal Sita ingin ikut masuk ke dalam kuburannya untuk membuktikan bahwa siksa kubur tidak ada dan agama tidak nyata. Namun, tentunya ada konsekuensi yang mengerikan bagi mereka yang tak percaya.

title: Menantu dan Mertua
overview: Kelas Bintang kembali hadir dengan paket drama berjudul Menantu dan Mertua

title: Dear David
overview: Kehidupan seorang murid SMA pintar berubah total ketika blog fantasinya yang provokatif tentang orang yang ia sukai bocor ke semua orang di sekolah.

title: Tegar
overview: Tegar (10), seorang anak berkebutuhan khusus yang menginginkan bisa seperti anak pada umumnya, berteman dan bersekolah. Di hari ulang tahunnya yang ke-10, Tegar mengutarakan impiannya kepada sang Kakek. Namun, keputusan Kakek untuk mewujudkan impian Tegar justru membuat Kakek dan Ibu berselisih. Akhirnya, Tegar memutuskan untuk pergi dari rumah demi mengejar mimpinya.

title: Pengabdi Setan 2: Communion
overview: Beberapa tahun setelah berhasil menyelamatkan diri dari kejadian mengerikan yang membuat mereka kehilangan ibu dan si bungsu Ian, Rini dan adik-adiknya, Toni dan Bondi, serta Bapak tinggal di rumah susun karena percaya tinggal di rumah susun aman jika terjadi sesuatu karena ada banyak orang. Namun, mereka segera menyadari bahwa tinggal bersama banyak orang mungkin juga sangat berbahaya, jika mereka tidak sangat mengenali siapa saja yang menjadi tetangga mereka. Pada sebuah malam penuh teror, Rini dan Keluarganya harus kembali menyelamatkan diri. Tapi kali ini, mungkin sudah terlambat untuk lari.

title: Ratu Ilmu Hitam
overview: Keluarga-keluarga di panti asuhan itu diteror. Seseorang ingin mereka mati, rupanya dengan ilmu hitam yang sangat mematikan. Dia punya dendam dan dia juga lahir karena dosa-dosa anak-anak yatim yang membentuknya menjadi ratu ilmu hitam.

title: Perempuan Tanah Jahanam
overview: Seorang operator pintu tol pergi ke kampung leluhurnya dengan harapan mendapatkan harta warisan, hingga akhirnya ia menemukan fakta yang meresahkan tentang masa lalunya.

title: DreadOut
overview: Sekelompok siswa SMA memutuskan untuk membuat siaran langsung aktivitas mereka di dalam gedung apartemen berhantu, tetapi akhirnya mereka malah membuka portal ke neraka.

title: The Night Comes For Us
overview: Seorang tukang pukul bernama Ito (Joe Taslim) kembali ke keluarga kriminalnya di Jakarta setelah bekerja dengan sebuah Triad Asia Tenggara yang kejam. Dia terperangkap dalam sebuah intrik pengkhianatan dan kekacauan saat Triad tersebut memulai sebuah kampanye berdarah untuk ekspansi teritorial mereka.

title: Sabrina
overview: MAIRA hidup bahagia di pernikahan barunya bersama AIDEN, pembuat boneka Sabrina. Tapi kebahagiaan mereka belum sempurna karena VANYA, anak angkat sekaligus keponakan Aiden yang yang piatu belum bisa menerima kehadiran Maira sebagai ibunya karena Vanya masih belum bisa merelakan kepergian ANDINI, bundanya yang sudah meninggal. Suatu hari, Vanya melakukan permainan ‘Pensil Charlie’ untuk memanggil bundanya dan kejanggalan-kejanggalan pun mulai terjadi. Maira dan Aiden Adak percaya, hingga akhirnya Maira mengalami serentetan kejadian menakutkan dan mereka melihat sendiri sosok Andini. Maira pun memanggil BU LARAS, seorang paranormal yang dulu pernah membantunya. Tapi Andini ternyata bukanlah Andini, melainkan iblis keji bernama BAGHIAH yang menetap di boneka Sabrina dan menginginkan tubuh manusia

title: Pengabdi Setan
overview: Setelah sakit aneh selama tiga tahun, Ibu akhirnya meninggal dunia. Bapak lalu memutuskan untuk bekerja di luar kota meninggalkan anak-anak. Tak lama kemudian, anak-anak merasa bahwa Ibu kembali berada di rumah. Situasi menjadi mencekam ketika mereka mengetahui bahwa Ibu datang bukan sekadar untuk menjenguk, melainkan untuk menjemput mereka.

title: Danur
overview: Film ini bercerita tentang Risa di hari ulang tahunnya ke-8, Risa dengan polosnya meminta seorang teman agar ia tidak kesepian lagi. Namun ternyata ibunya, Elly, mulai curiga mendapati anaknya sering tertawa sendiri dan bermain seolah-olah dengan banyak teman, padahal Elly hanya melihatnya bermain sendiri! Elly mencari jalan untuk memisahkan Risa dari sahabat nya yang ternyata hantu.

title: Headshot
overview: Pemuda misterius bangun tersentak dari keadaan koma selama berbulan-bulan, dirawat hingga pulih oleh seorang murid kedokteran bernama Ailin ketika ditemukan sekarat dengan sebuah luka tembakan di kepala. Seperti sebuah kelahiran baru dan, menyadari pemuda ini telah kehilangan ingatan dan indentitas dirinya, Ailin menamakan pemuda tersebut Ishmael.

title: The Window
overview: Dewi pulang ke kampungnya di Jogjakarta, setelah sepuluh tahun meninggalkan tempat itu.  Sebuah surat dan potongan berita koran yang dikirim ibunya, membuat ia harus kembali ke kampungnya: kehamilan misterius Dee, kakaknya yang cacat mental. Dewi mendapati situasi di rumah orangtuanya yang tak berubah. Yang berubah adalah kehamilan Dee dan pemandangan di balik jendela besar rumahnya yang silih berganti. Dewi  lalu mengenal Priyanto yang baru setahun tinggal di kampung itu.  Priyanto dan Dewi menjalin kisah asmara yang tak biasa. Joko, teman kecil Dewi, cemburu. Kedatangan Dewi menguak masa lalunya yang tak selesai.

title: Sawadikap
overview: OCEP (Zaky Zimah) mendapat tiket liburan ke Thailand untuk 3 orang. Bersama sahabatnya BRYAN (Kiki Drajat) dan ARIEL (Lionil Hendrik).  Saat mereka tiba, rupanya sedang ada perayaan Pee Ta Khoon, sebuah perayaan adat Bangkok dimana arwah orang yang sudah meninggal, turun kembali ke bumi.

title: Miss Call
overview: Mitha sering me-miss call orang lain, lalu menakuti-nakuti orang tersebut bila orang tersebut menelponnya. Suatu malam sepulang acara pesta ulang tahun sahabatnya, Mitha me-miss call nomor acak yang ternyata pemiliknya sedang bertengkar hebat. Pertengkaran itu berakhir dengan kematian si pemilik nomor yang bernama Chika.

title: Filosofi Kopi
overview: Sebuah kedai kopi yang berjuang untuk membayar utangnya, sekaligus mempertahankan prinsipnya.

title: Sepatu Dahlan
overview: Cerita dari novel berjudul sama yaitu Sepatu Dahlan, yang berkisah tentang Dahlan Iskan, dia adalah seorang mantan Menteri BUMN indonesia yang semasa kecil hidupnya amatlah sulit dan sederhana, dia terus berjuang untuk tetap bisa belajar demi cita-cita serta membanggakan orang tuanya.

title: The Raid 2: Berandal
overview: RAMA (Iko Uwais) adalah seorang polisi baru yang meninggalkan ISA, istrinya yang tengah hamil tua untuk melakukan tugas berbahaya. Setelah berhasil mempertahankan dirinya dari 30 lantai apartemen milik raja gembong narkotik TAMA, RAMA direkrut oleh BUNAWAR, kepala polisi yang dikenal jujur dan mempunyai reputasi yang bersih, sebagai polisi yang menyamar.

title: Cahaya Kecil
overview: Gilang Krishna (Petra Sihombing) tidak melanjutkan kuliah musiknya di Amerika karena ayahnya, Arya Krisna, (Andy /rif) masuk penjara akibat narkoba. Gilang marah pada ayahnya yang begitu ia cintai dan kagumi. Abraham (Verdi Solaiman), mantan manajer Arya, mengajak Gilang terjun ke dunia musik. Ia memanfaatkan momen kesedihan itu, mendramatisirnya dan menjualnya. Gilang tampil tanpa nama belakang Krisna. Sukses, Ia juga pacaran dengan Saskia (Taskya Namya), model.  Arya keluar dari penjara. Gilang tak mau menerima ayahnya. Hubungan ayah-anak ini jadi sorotan media. Sikap gilang nyaris menjatuhkan namanya. Gilang berbalik sikap. Di depan umum ia jadi anak yang baik, tapi di belakang ia tetap belum bisa memaafkan ayahnya. Gilang bersikap demikian demi popularitas, Arya demi dekat anaknya.

title: After the Dark
genres: Drama, Fantasi, Cerita Fiksi, Cerita Seru

title: The Raid
overview: Sekelompok tim SWAT tiba di sebuah blok apartemen yang tidak terurus dengan misi menangkap pemiliknya seorang raja bandar narkotik bernama TAMA. Blok ini tidak pernah digerebek atau pun tersentuh oleh Polisi sebelumnya.

title: Merantau
overview: Di Minangkabau, Sumatra Barat, Merantau adalah tradisi yang harus dijalankan setiap anak laki-laki. Yuda (Iko Uwais), pesilat Harimau handal, dalam persiapan akhir untuk memulai perantauannya. Ia harus meninggalkan keluarganya, ibu tercinta, Wulan (Christine Hakim), dan udanya, Yayan (Donny Alamsyah), kenyamanan dan keindahan kampung halamannya, dan membuat nama untuk dirinya di keserabutan kota Jakarta.

title: Pandawa Lima
overview: Pandu Dewanata kembali ke negeri Astina dengan memboyong tiga putri yang dimenangkannya dalam sayembara, yaitu Dewi Kunti, Dewi Madrin, dan Dewi Gandari. Tetapi Pandu tidak begitu tamak mengawini ketiga putri itu. Ia menawarkan di antara mereka untuk dijodohkan kepada abangnya, Destarata dan adiknya, Abiyasa.  Abiyasa menolak tawaran itu, sedang Destarata menerimanya setelah dibujuk. Tak satupun dari ketiga putri itu ingin dikawini Destarata yang buta. Masing-masing mencari akal untuk tidak terpilih. Karena ulahnya yang keliru, justru Dewi Gandari yang terpilih. Hal itu membuat dendamnya kepada Dewi Kunti dan Dewi Madrin.

title: Delapan Pendjuru Angin
overview: Armansyah Perkasa Alam, a rising movie and radio star, receives a lot of fan letters that he uses to indulge his playboy behaviour. His friend, Trisno, keeps cautioning him to no avail. Armansyah begins to juggle too many appointments with too many girls. Finally, all eight girls that he is trying to seduce realise his trick and they all leave Armansyah.

title: Biola
overview: A student (Arfandi) is very depressed, for being known as a bastard child or “anak haram”, the original title of Pramoedya Ananta Toer’s story, on which the film is based on. Only one of the teachers (Frans Harahap) is understanding and willing to help.

title: Djajaprana
overview: Driven by his attraction to Layonsari, the King orders his adopted son, Jayaprana, who is Layonsari's husband, to go far away to battle insurgents. Meanwhile, the King also sends Sawunggaling to kill Jayaprana and he is successful. But Layonsari commits suicide as she refuses to submit to the King's demands.

title: Sengketa
overview: The film tells a story about a family with six children. The father is often angry with everyone except the eldest child (Mieke Wijaya). Then the family situation deteriorates further when mother falls ill and is hospitalized. Finally, problems are solved thanks to the calmness and charm of the third sibling (Indriati Iskak).

title: Three Fugitives
overview: Set after the Indonesian War of Independence, Maman arrives to his village only to meet Mat Codet, the leader of a rogue gang who just escaped prison.

title: Tandjung Katung
overview: Disappointed with her marriage, Sahara left Medan and moved to Jakarta, forgetting her profession as a ronggeng dancer. There she met Effendi who invited her to create a national social dance by creating from regional dances.

title: Anakku Sajang
overview: Hendra steals money to pay for the medical treatment of his sick child, Onnie. His wife, Lastri rejects his well-intentioned but wrongful act. Hendra then leaves his family to evade the police.

title: Gadis Sesat
overview: Through Poppy and her boyfriend, Hasan, Elina meets Abdullah and becomes his lover. Then Elina starts to lead a wayward life. Her older sister, Tuty, tries to stop her but Elina chooses to continue her relationship and gets married. Then Tuty's warning comes true, as Abdullah is irresponsible. After Elina gets a divorce, she tries to find Tuty again but fails. But in the end, the two siblings manage to reunite.

title: The Three Maidens
overview: Three sisters—Nunung, Nana and Nenny—are being raised by their grandmother in Jakarta after their mother's death. Though the sisters' father Sukandar lives with them, he is too involved in his own work to pay them heed.

title: Pesan Terachir
overview: Wibowo's household was getting worse day by day. This was caused by the death of Lastri (his wife) whom he loved very much. Before his wife took her last breath, she asked Wibowo to take Lasmi (Lastri's younger sister) as his future wife. The message was carried out. But the sorrow still gripped Wibowo's heart.

title: Saodah
overview: While it is uncertain, the film is believed to be inspired by the story of Nyai Dasima, about the terrible fate of a rich widow who ends up as a murder victim because of her wealth.

title: Terang Bulan Terang di Kali
overview: Even though the girl (Lely Sulastri) already has a poor boyfriend (B. Nast Efdal), the father (Udjang) accepts the "proposal" brought by the matchmaker (Wolly Sutinah). Fortunately, the mother (Fifi Young) does not agree, so that it can disrupt the smooth process of the sickly future son-in-law (Rasjid AL). "Happy ending", because the prospective groom collapsed in front of his future wife's door...

title: Bertjerai Kasih
overview: Teacher Prapto (Rd Sukarno) helped build the nation by educating the people on a mountain slope in Central Java. One day the mountain erupted, the people fled. Lasmijah (Risa Umami) left her daughter Yati to follow her husband, Prapto. In fact, Prapto rushed home. Prapto only met Yati, and then lived in his hometown, Salatiga. There he met Sutinah (Tina Melinda), then married her. Meanwhile, Lasmijah, who was disabled, looked for Prapto and Yati.

title: Djuara 1960
overview: Guntur, a boxer, checks into a hotel on the day before his match, with his coach. In the hotel, Guntur stays in a room next to Udel and his wife. To secure victory, coach Hasan Sanusi poisons Guntur’s eyes. After dropping Guntur at the hospital, Tjepot, his coach, sees Udel, who resembles Guntur. He persuades Udel to fight in Guntur’s place. At first Udel resists, but he finally agrees, after Guntur’s girlfriend, also mistakes Udel for Guntur, by hugging him. At the end, his wife is also very proud of him. After the match when he manages to knock his opponent out, the two women begin to fight over him. The problem is solved when Guntur shows up.

title: Gambang Semarang
overview: A sad story enlivened by song. It is worth praising Sukarno M. Noor's performance in his first important role. The use of the title ("Gambang Semarang", which was originally "Eliminate KMB") was only for commercial considerations, because the song title for "tanda" was very popular.

title: Setulus Hatiku
overview: Maryani who loves Hartono, her childhood friend. But because she could never express it, compared to her younger sister, Rusmini. Maryani had to let Hartono marry Rusmini.

title: Seniman Desa
overview: As a singer, Amalia is much loved by men. In addition to being beautiful, Amalia has also just received an inheritance. Jenal, who is only interested in Amalia's wealth, tries to approach her. Finally, Amalia finds out Jenal's motives and she chooses to leave the city and move to the village.

title: Dibalik Dinding
overview: Thanks to the success of the film "Crisis", produced by Perfini, there is a tendency to make similar stories. There are no main characters in this film, except for the somewhat prominent ones, namely the patient teacher (A. Hamid Arief) and his talkative wife (Tina Melinda). It also depicts the lives of several families in a house like in "Crisis".

title: Tahu Sama Tahu
overview: A Sumarna, the deputy head of an office in Jakarta, is suspicious of Karta and several other employees because they live very luxuriously. He asks his boss, Subroto, to investigate and take action against them. Subroto, who feels that he is committing fraud with Karta et al, negotiates to overthrow Sumarna by using Nani, a widow of a dragger. Nani succeeds in taking Surmarna away from his wife, Hayati, and makes Sumarna also commit corruption. Sumarna is arrested and sentenced to five years.  Hayati, who is divorced, lives in the village with her child in her parents' house. Because this provides a good education for her child, she returns to Jakarta. She meets Amat, Sumarna's driver, who then invites her to the house of Dul ​​and Mirah, a vegetable seller. Hayati sells rujak.  After five years, Sumarna is released from prison, while Subroto et al are sent to prison because their corruption is exposed. When walking in front of Dul's house, Amat recognizes him.

title: See You Again
overview: Nurwati's relationship with Lieutenant Sutrisno was supported by her father, but opposed by her mother because the lieutenant was not rich, and her mother preferred Tirtoroso, who always looked classy.  Sutrisno, from Yogya in mid-1946 was assigned to Bali via Banyuwangi beach.  The attempt to go to the Island of the Gods was successful, even though he was forced to receive treatment from the residents of the island of Nusa Penida.  After returning to Yogya, Nurwati became Tirtoroso's mistress.

title: Tjorak Dunia
overview: Because he was injured during the war, Johan got a scar on his face. Because it was difficult to get a job with an ugly face. Johan almost became a criminal before being saved by a mother and her blind child.

title: Lagi-Lagi Krisis
overview: Husin bin Said (Udjang) suddenly got the inspiration to become a shaman. He put up a nameplate. So in droves of people came asking for help: people who intend to become cultural attaches, members of parliament, wives of officials whose husbands are dating again, producers, aspiring film stars, etc. For some reason, film producer Henry Bross (S. Bono) and aspiring film star Mimi (Diana Subroto) have succeeded in making Husin try their best to help carry out their intention. This story is also the main pillar of the film, besides being an opportunity for the director to mock the world of film. Moreover, then came Husin's friend, Pedro (Rd. Ismail), an old and unused performer who still had illusions about his triumph as an actor. Husin's house is next door to the family of Jaka Prawira-Mariam (R. Sukarno, Tina Melinda). To this house came their in-laws, RA Berlian (Edifah Hanoem), a controlling noble.

title: Exalted Guest
overview: An impending visit from a VIP causes chaos and confusion in the small, isolated village of Sukaslamet. Things take a hilarious turn when the herbal medicine seller is mistaken for the exalted guest and is accorded a ceremonial welcome in the most elaborate Javanese style.

title: Golden Queen
overview: A wealthy man marries twice. His jealous second wife murders the first and gets away with it and then plots, along with her daughter, to do away with the stepdaughter.

title: Djakarta Bukan Hollywood
overview: Record distributor, Rasyid, assigns the famous singer, Burhan, to enchant Rooswati in the Puncak area. The girl's father wishes to maintain the noble bloodline by pairing off his daughter to Bimayu. Rooswati runs away, and she roams about using her maid's name, Suparni. In her journey, she encounters Burhan. Finally, Rooswati comes back to Puncak on her own will. To celebrate her return, a music group is hired as entertainment. Burhan writes one of the songs the group plays, entitled "Djakarta Bukan Hollywood", a song about how young people are imitating western lifestyles.

title: Debu Revolusi
overview: Arman suffers a severe wound from the second military clash in December 1948 and is nursed by the village head and his daughter, Srihati. When Indonesia gains full sovereignty in 1950, he returns to Jakarta. Then Arman is carried away by the big city life. He meets Martini and later on marries the modern girl. When Srihati goes to the city to find him, she is disappointed. But later she meets Kasim. At that time, Arman is having gambling problems and he is sent to prison due to embezzlement. After he finishes his prison sentence, he tries to find Srihati at the village but she is already married to Kasim. So Arman becomes the dust of revolution, blown by the wind to nothingness.

title: Senen Raja
overview: Ismail leaves his wife, Sutrisni, in Bekasi, in order to look for a job in Jakarta. Although his brother, Iskandar, persuades him to do illegal work with him, Ismail refuses. Since Iskandar does not deliver the money Ismail is sending to his wife, Sutrisni goes to the city to find her husband. But Sutrisni does not find him and marries Wongso. Finally, Ismail finds her again to solve the complicated chain of events.

title: Kali Brantas (Melati Kali Brantas)
overview: Irawani and Hidayat get engaged to each other. Irawani relates the story of her parents, Irawan and Sunarti. When the couple goes through a hard time, Irawan moves to Batavia to look for work and leaves his wife and daughter behind. But when he succeeds in the city, he gets carried away though it is his father-law, Sunarno, who employs him. After she grows up, Irawani becomes a singer and dancer, and Irawan is crazy about her. Knowing this, his new wife expels him from the house. So once again, Irawan becomes a beggar, just like the first time when he arrived in Jakarta.

title: Kebaja Fantasi
overview: Martono falls in love with Susilowati, who is called the "Kebaya Fantasi". But Susilowati's father, Dahlan, opposes the relationship. Martono is just a driver, while Dahlan, a car repair shop owner, prefers a rich man as son-in-law. Dahlan pairs off "Kebaya Fantasi" to Darwis, a rich kid. But Lily, a female bandit, already has her heart set on Darwis. Because of Lily, Darwis is arrested by the police. He is involved in a robbery that is masterminded by Lily. This paves the way for Martono to approach Susilowati. Moreover, Dahlan's business is actually funded by Amijaya, Martono's long lost father.

title: Burung Merpati
overview: In school, Laila goes steady with Hamid. Her father, Abdullah the trader, opposes their relationship as he thinks it will hamper her education. When told to study at home, Laila is still trying to meet her boyfriend. One day, Abdullah is on the brink of bankruptcy. Then Usman, the tycoon, comes along and helps him. So Abdullah feels obligated to give his consent when Usman proposes to marry his daughter. But Laila is treated badly by her in-laws so she runs away, without knowing that her father has died. Fortunately, she encounters Hamid, and together they live happily ever after.

title: Malu-Malu Kutjing
overview: Sugesti feels jealous because Rochijat falls in love with her sister, Bardini, and he only considers her as a friend. To cope with her disappointment, Sugesti becomes a lead singer in a theater group led by Subroto. She stops singing when she marries the loan shark, Surachman, to pay for the debts of the theater group. Meanwhile, Bardini is at a loose end and works at Sugesti's house. She pretends not to know her and treats her badly. After dealing with various challenges, Bardini marries Rochijat. When she visits her father's grave, she runs into Sugesti, who is now a poor woman, after her husband is sent to jail.

title: Djakarta di Waktu Malam
overview: Sriwardhani becomes a singer at "Happy World", after her father is killed by a gang of robbers. There she meets Edy Sumarno and they get married without Edy's mother consent. When Edy gets sick, Sri asks her mother-in-law for money to buy medicine. But the mother asks Sri to divorce her son for the money. Sri accepts this for her husband's sake. When Edy recovers, his mother arranges a marriage for him. However, the marriage does not work well and his wife dies in a car accident. Edy's mother regrets her decision and tells him to go look for Sri again.

title: Sri Asih
overview: Because her father was seriously ill in Semarang, and Sri Asih did not have time to leave, Sri Asih only took her mother to the station. After the train departed, Sri Asih heard a whisper, that the train was about to explode, because on the bridge there was dynamite that had been plotted. Immediately use the talisman, and Sri Asih becomes agile and can fly. The dynamite was thrown and exploded in the river, though before that he had to face resistance from the bandits. Then, Sri Asih followed the horde of the Black Garuda and managed to destroy it.

title: Djubah Hitam
overview: The Corsana Kingdom is winning the war against the Parsini kingdom. But the King's brother, Angkara conspires with the enemy to topple the King. Commander Imam (Rd Endang) manages to escape and disguises himself as the Black Robe to fight against evil. One day, he helps out a trader, and the trader's daughter, Suciana, who falls in love with him. But Imam already has a girlfriend, Indahya. After Imam's struggle to reinstall the king succeeds, he marries Indahya, while Suciana is proposed to by Satria.

title: After the Curfew
overview: A hero of revolution returns to civilian life to find the new society very different from the ideals he fought for.

title: Rela
overview: When his twin brother is abducted and considered dead, the younger twin marries his brother's lover. Suddenly, the older twin returns but when he finds his former lover now married to his brother, he decides to return to the forest where he had been held hostage all this time.

title: Antara Tugas dan Tjinta
overview: Produced as a profile on the Military Police Corps, we see the romance between Wati and Karmawan. Subur, on the other hand, is treated by Wati as a casual friend. However, Wati's parents pair off their daughter to Subur. The conflict between personal interest and professional duty begins when Subur is captured by a gang of thugs. As a commanding officer, Karmawan is assigned to rescue his subordinate, Subur, whereas he will have a chance with Wati again, if he does not do anything about it.

title: Bintang Baru
overview: Even though he was an orphan, Herman was serious about developing himself in the arts. Moreover, he received encouragement from Kustari, his mother's niece.
